svg.text: Single-owner enrollment (zero public signup) · 4 independent trust locks · 7-gate runtime admission · 1-tap revocation
DAY 0 · OWNER-INITIATED DEVICE PAIRING (OUT-OF-BAND ONLY — NO RANDOM AEGIS CAN CONNECT)
Signed on HAL Core via HAL_TOKEN_SECRET
Paired credentials provisioned out-of-band -> Day 1 Runtime Sessions
Not revoked (checked on auth & every RPC)
HMAC sig + expiry + subject & max_risk_tier <= peer cap
Every allow & deny decision is appended to SHA-256 hal-audit
ZERO-TRUST ENROLLMENT INVARIANT: NO PUBLIC SIGNUP · NO RANDOM AEGIS ACCESS
Master HAL_TOKEN_SECRET never leaves HAL Core · Unpaired peers dropped at wg0/PF before TCP · Revoke kills open sessions
